A sign telling people not to enter a place. This door has a no entry sign.
no parking · /noʊ ˈpɑrkɪŋ/ · phrase · Phrase · New
A sign telling drivers not to leave a vehicle in a place. There is a no parking sign outside.
out of order · /aʊt əv ˈɔrdər/ · phrase · Phrase · New

articulation.label: sign
articulation.alt: sign: /s/ → /aɪ/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
/a/: Start with the tongue low and jaw open.
/ɪ/: Glide up and forward; narrow the jaw gap.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
